slides.title: Your first international invoice, in six pieces of paper.
slides.subtitle: What an Indian freelancer or consultant needs before a client abroad can pay them without a mess later. Saved by people who learned it the expensive way.

slides.title: One page. Signed before you start.

items.name: Scope, in three lines
items.replaces: What you deliver, by when, what is out of scope.

items.name: Rate and currency
items.replaces: Fixed fee or day rate. USD, EUR or GBP. Never 'to be discussed'.

items.name: Payment within 15 days
items.replaces: Half up front on anything over $2,000.

items.name: IP transfers on payment
items.replaces: Not on delivery. They own it when you are paid.

items.name: 30 days' notice, either side
items.replaces: So nobody is trapped.

slides.note: We give the template away free. Link in the first comment.

slides.title: What goes on it that an Indian invoice usually misses.

items.name: Your name, PAN, address
items.replaces: And GSTIN if you have one.

items.name: Client's legal name and country
items.replaces: Their registered address, not a first name and an email.

items.name: Currency and amount in words
items.replaces: 'USD 2,000 (two thousand US dollars)'.

items.name: The export line, if GST-registered
items.replaces: 'Supply meant for export under LUT without payment of IGST'.

items.name: How to pay you
items.replaces: Skydo or Wise or Payoneer details. Not a bare SWIFT code with no instructions.

slides.title: Every inward remittance needs one. Pick it, don't let the bank guess.

items.name: P0802
items.replaces: Software consultancy and implementation

items.name: P0807
items.replaces: Other IT services: support, data processing, hosting

items.name: P1006
items.replaces: Business and management consultancy, PR

items.name: P1007
items.replaces: Advertising, trade fair, market research

items.name: P1099
items.replaces: Other services not covered above (design, writing, tutoring often land here)

slides.note: The wrong code means a call from the bank and a delay. Skydo and Payoneer ask you for it up front; a plain bank wire may not.

slides.title: The certificate that proves the money came from abroad.

items.name: Foreign Inward Remittance Advice
items.replaces: One per payment. It shows the sender, the currency, the amount, the purpose code.

items.name: Why you need it
items.replaces: GST zero-rating on exports, and the day a tax notice asks where ₹18 lakh came from.

items.name: Where it comes from
items.replaces: Skydo: instant, included. Payoneer: free, digital. Banks: ask, and often pay for it.

slides.note: Keep every FIRA in one folder with its invoice. Future you, at tax time, will be grateful.

slides.title: Export of services is zero-rated. Only if you file one form a year.

items.name: Register above ₹20 lakh
items.replaces: Mandatory once turnover crosses it, even if 100% is export.

items.name: File the LUT (form RFD-11)
items.replaces: Every financial year, online, before you invoice. Then you charge no IGST.

items.name: Still file GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B
items.replaces: Zero-rated is not the same as exempt from filing.

items.name: Get paid in foreign currency
items.replaces: Receipt in INR without FIRC can cost you the export status.

slides.note: Rules as we understand them in November 2026. Confirm with a CA before you rely on any of this.

slides.title: Section 44ADA: declare half, skip the books.

items.name: Presumptive scheme for professionals
items.replaces: Declare 50% of gross receipts as profit. No audited books.

items.name: Limit ₹50 lakh
items.replaces: ₹75 lakh if at least 95% of receipts are digital, which for this work they are.

items.name: Advance tax
items.replaces: One instalment by 15 March. Miss it and interest runs.

items.name: Renumbered from 1 April 2026
items.replaces: The Income-tax Act 2025 changes section numbers. Search 'presumptive taxation for professionals', not '44ADA'.

slides.note: If your real expenses are far below 50%, this scheme is a gift. If they are above, keep books instead.

slides.title: Six pieces of paper. One evening.
slides.body: Contract, invoice, purpose code, FIRA, LUT, 44ADA. Save this for the week your first client abroad says yes. The one-page contract template is free in the first comment.
